nom: COSRX Airy-Light Clear Sunscreen Stick SPF 50

segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, stinging, or redness, contrasting with other sunscreens that have caused rashes for them.
segments.oily: Reviewers describe the stick as mattifying and not greasy, with one noting it helps control shine left by moisturizers underneath.

concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports her dark spots started to fade after use, though this is a single account not echoed elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts or clogged pores, and one says it lowkey helped reduce her acne; no reviewer describes worsened breakouts.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with acne-prone or sensitive skin report no redness or irritation, a contrast several draw with other sunscreens that left a red rash.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the finish as matte and non-greasy, including one who says it helps mattify skin over moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: Water and sweat resistant, no eye sting
Wish for a smaller travel size

extraits.texte: I am acne prone which limits me from most products, but this sunscreen didn't break me out instead it lowkey helped reduce it, the formula is great, and my dark spots started to fade which has never happened with other sunscreen.

Have to say, I have tried every sunscreen possible: they are either too greasy, burn eyes, smell to 'sunscreeny', leave a white residue, break me out, leave a red rash with my sensitive skin,or feel too heavy. This is hands down a keeper! Ingredients cause none of these problems. It is light and can even wear under makeup leaving a smooth texture or alone on a 10 mile hike, with no running in eyes! Fantastic!
No breakouts or clogged pores. Easy application with smooth matte look. Ingredients are great for my sensitive skin, as most sunscreens irritate my skin.
I have acne prone skin, no pores clogged or redness with this sunscreen. No irritation at all! amazing.

extraits.titre: This is the best sunstick I've ever used!
extraits.texte: It's not greasy, you can't even feel it on your skin, and you can apply it over makeup without ruining it. It's water-resistant and perfect to take anywhere. I absolutely love it! My sensitive, acne-prone skin loves it too. No breakouts, no clogged pores.

This truly is airy light. I have never seen sunscreen like this before. The product itself looked and felt so smooth like plastic I actually wondered if there was yet another plastic cover on top. You barely feel it as you apply it, no greasiness like other products. I actually think it helps mattify my skin after moisturizers leave it looking shiny. Also very compact so can pack it in purse for reapplication. I would definitely recommend this to others and continue purchasing it for myself

this is not my "all over" sunscreen - I use it for spots where I want extra coverage, like my cheeks and brows (they're microbladed and need UV protection), and for touch-ups. it's perfectly clear, matte and smooth, so it's a great primer too! the best part is that it doesn't make my sensitive skin break out or sting. it's also travel friendly, but it would be nice if they started making a smaller size for that.

reserve: All 22 reviews are 5-star, so no critical or lower-rated review is available to include for balance.
